d:
In this episode of Mind the Gap, Shrimoyee sits down with Saffron Vadher, a British-Indian international model who went from a casual gap-year idea to becoming the exclusive face of Burberry in just three weeks.
Behind the high-fashion campaigns, British Vogue covers, and Parisian glamour lies a foundational story of survival. Diagnosed with aggressive leukemia at just three years old, Saffron developed a quiet, unbreakable resilience that allowed her to navigate a notoriously intense industry entirely on her own terms.
